result.stdout:
cs2gs - C# to G# migration tool (ADR-0115)

Usage:
  cs2gs migrate [options]
  cs2gs validate --corpus <repo-root> --migrated <dir> [--shard i/N | --app <id>...]
  cs2gs capture-test-oracle --corpus <repo-root> --out <dir> [--exclude <path>...]
  cs2gs report --run <runDir> [--out <file-or-dir>]
  cs2gs coverage [--write] [--repo-root <dir>]
  cs2gs triage list --run <runDir> [--gaps <file>]
  cs2gs triage file-issues --run <runDir> [--gaps <file>] [--file] [--limit N] [--milestone M]
  cs2gs triage sync [--gaps <file>] [--write] [--no-test-reason <why>]

migrate options:
  --corpus <dir>    Source repository root (default: tools/cs2gs/corpus).
  --out <dir>       Empty destination repository (required by default).
  --artifacts <dir> Validation runs root (default: <out>.cs2gs-runs).
  --diagnostic-run  Preserve the historical timestamped corpus/CI layout.
  --app <id>        Diagnostic-run only; migrate one app (repeatable).
  --gsc <path>      Override gsc.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Compiler/gsc.dll).
  --gsgen <path>    Override gsgen.dll (default: out/bin/<Config>/Gsgen.Cli/gsgen.dll); issue #2215.
                    With --diagnostic-run, --out is the runs root.
  --config <name>   Build config used to find gsc (default: Release).
  --exclude <path>  Repository migration only: exclude apps whose repo-relative id
                    starts with <path> (repeatable; e2e fixtures, non-app projects).
  --passthrough <path>  Repository migration only: exclude matching apps from
                    translation but preserve their original C# project and sources.
  --baseline <file> Gate on the gap ledger (tools/cs2gs/triage/gaps.json): fail only on
                    NEW or REGRESSED fingerprints; known-open gaps are tolerated.
  --baseline-strict Also fail on STALE ledger entries (nightly mode).
  --test-allowlist <file>  Test-parity failure allow-list (issue #3885); default:
                    <corpus>/tools/cs2gs/selfmig-test-allowlist.json when present.
  --csharp-test-oracle <dir>  Check mirrored test pr
[truncated]

result.stdout:
cs2gs validate - validate an already-migrated tree for a subset of apps (issue #3668)

Usage:
  cs2gs validate --corpus <repo-root> --migrated <dir> [options]

options:
  --corpus <dir>     The ORIGINAL repository root the tree was migrated from (required).
  --migrated <dir>   The already-migrated tree to validate (required).
  --artifacts <dir>  Runs root for this shard's logs/triage (default: <migrated>.cs2gs-runs).
  --manifests <dir>  The migrate run directory holding per-app validation-context.json
                     (default: the newest run directory under --artifacts).
  --app <id>         Validate this app (repeatable).
  --shard <i>/<N>    Validate every Nth app starting at i (1-based); excludes --app.
  --exclude <path>   MUST match the migrate pass exactly — it defines the discovered set,
                     not the executed subset. Narrowing it breaks reference resolution.
  --passthrough <path>  MUST match migrate: exclude from validation while preserving
                     the original C# project in the migrated tree.
  --config <name>    Build config used to find gsc and the SDK package (default: Release).
  --gsc <path>       Override gsc.dll.
  --gsgen <path>     Override gsgen.dll.
  --test-allowlist <file>  Test-parity failure allow-list (issue #3885); default:
                     <corpus>/tools/cs2gs/selfmig-test-allowlist.json when present.
  --csharp-test-oracle <dir>  C# test-case names from `cs2gs capture-test-oracle`; every
                     mirrored test project is checked name for name (issue #4633).
  --test-name-baseline <file>  Justified per-test-name differences; default:
                     <corpus>/tools/cs2gs/selfmig-test-name-baseline.json when present.
  --count-only-test-parity  Knowingly skip per-test-name parity (one of this or
                     --csharp-test-oracle is required).

result.stdout:
cs2gs capture-test-oracle - list the C# test cases per-test-name parity compares against (issue #4633)

Usage:
  cs2gs capture-test-oracle --corpus <repo-root> --out <dir> [options]

options:
  --corpus <dir>     The C# repository root (required).
  --out <dir>        Where to write one oracle per test project (required); each file is named
                     <sanitized app id>-<8-hex hash>.csharp-tests.json.
  --config <name>    Build configuration (default: Release).
  --manifests <dir>  The migrate run directory; its validation manifests add the evaluated
                     MSBuild IsTestProject to the classification (recommended).
  --no-build         List already-built test assemblies.
  --app <id>         Capture only this app (repeatable).
  --exclude <path>   Same meaning as for migrate/validate.
  --passthrough <path>  Same meaning as for migrate/validate.
